locale_code.description: Not translated: the language code of this catalog (BCP 47), for the lang attribute.

locale_dir.description: Not translated: the writing direction of this catalog, ltr or rtl.

extension_name.description: The brand. Arabic has its own name, بلا موسيقى (“without music”); keep Musicless in Latin letters in any other language.

extension_description.message: Removes most of the background music from YouTube™ videos and keeps the voices. Everything runs on your computer.
extension_description.description: Store summary and extensions-page description. 132 characters at most.

control_name.description: Name and tooltip of the player button while removal is off or has failed. A click removes music, or opens recovery choices after a failure.

control_on.description: Name and tooltip while removal is on. Restores the original audio for this video without starting a paused video.

control_setup.description: Player button before consent; opens the first-run disclosure.

notice_working.description: Under the spinner in the middle of the video while it waits a moment for the first audio without music (at the start, or after a jump).

notice_done.description: Said once by screen readers when a wait ends and the video plays without its music.

notice_blocked.description: Name, read by screen readers, of the round play button in the middle of the video when the browser needs a click before it plays sound.

panel_title.description: Title of the failure dialog; the reason follows it.

panel_original.description: Failure dialog action: plays the unprocessed audio, including any music.

failure_protected.description: Copy-protected: the owner locked the video, as rented movies are.

failure_codec.message: Musicless can’t work with this video’s audio.

failure_missed.message: Reload this page to start removing music.
failure_missed.description: Under the title “Musicless is on” (done_heading), on a video that was already playing when the user turned Musicless on: its sound went by unread, and a reload is all it needs. The main button is “Reload page”.

failure_uncaptured.description: Musicless could not find this player’s sound (it may play in a part of the page Musicless cannot read).

failure_source.message: Musicless can’t access the sound in this video.

failure_slow.message: This is taking longer than expected. Try again in a moment.

failure_audio.message: The sound didn’t start. Try reloading the page.

failure_updated.message: Musicless was updated or turned off. Reload the page to continue.

setup_heading.description: Heading of the first-run page: what the user gets.

consent_text.message: Musicless uses the audio from the YouTube videos you watch to remove most of the music, all on your computer. It never saves or uploads the audio. Your settings may sync through Chrome Sync.
consent_text.description: Disclosure before any audio is read, on the first-run page and in the popup. Keep all facts: uses the audio of the videos watched on YouTube, only on the computer, never saves or uploads it, settings may sync through Chrome Sync.

consent_accept.description: The affirmative choice under the local-audio disclosure.

done_heading.description: After consent; also the title when an already-open video needs reloading.

done_step1_title.description: First next-step title when automatic removal is on.

done_step1_text.description: First next-step explanation when automatic removal is on.

done_step2_title.description: Second next-step title: allow a short preparation wait.

done_step2_text.message: Each video waits briefly at the start while the music is removed.
done_step2_text.description: Second next-step explanation: the video waits while music is removed.

done_step3_title.description: Third next-step title when automatic removal is on.

done_step3_text.message: Click {icon} in the player. Only that video changes.
done_step3_text.description: Third next-step explanation when automatic removal is on. Preserve {icon}; it becomes the crossed-out note.

done_step1_off_title.description: First next-step title when automatic removal is off.

done_step1_off_text.message: Click {icon} in the player to remove its music.
done_step1_off_text.description: First next-step explanation when automatic removal is off. Preserve {icon}; it becomes the plain note.

done_step3_off_title.description: Third next-step title when automatic removal is off.

done_step3_off_text.description: Third next-step explanation when automatic removal is off.

done_text.message: If YouTube was already open, reload that page.
done_text.description: Conditional reminder to reload YouTube pages that were already open before activation. Shown after activation on the welcome page and in the popup.

done_open.description: Button: opens youtube.com in this tab.

done_back.description: Button instead of “Open YouTube” when the page was opened from a video’s button: goes back to that tab and reloads it where the video was, so its music can be removed.

popup_autostart_label.description: The default for every video the user opens; changing it doesn't change the video already playing.

popup_default_on.message: Music is removed from every video you open. Click {icon} in a video to restore its original sound.
popup_default_on.description: Helper when the default is on. Preserve {icon}; it becomes the crossed-out note.

popup_one_video.message: Every video you open keeps its original sound. Click {icon} in a video to remove its music.
popup_one_video.description: Helper when the default is off. Preserve {icon}; it becomes the plain note.

link_help.description: Link to the help: how Musicless works and what to do; reporting a problem is one link further.

link_help_url.description: Not translated: the address of the help in this language (README's "Using Musicless"; docs/help.ar.md for Arabic).
